verdict.rationale: 1Password's Events API and Connect API references run an interactive Mintlify playground: a "Try it" panel sits next to each endpoint, with generated cURL samples. They are backed by downloadable, versioned OpenAPI specs. That delivers the core of the story for its REST API surfaces. The OpenAPI 404s on support.1password.com are a different host and do not contradict this. missing for 10: interactive/runnable reference for the CLI and SDK surfaces (prose and code only), independent or hands-on corroboration that the "Try it" calls actually execute.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples

citations.quote: The Events API and Connect API references run the Mintlify interactive playground ("Try it" renders next to the endpoint, e.g. POST /api/v2/auditevents, with generated cURL samples).
1Password publishes the Events API as a downloadable OpenAPI 3.0.0 document (semver 1.4.1), linked from the Events API reference
The 1Password Connect Server API likewise ships a downloadable OpenAPI document (3.0.2, version 1.8.1), linked from the Connect API reference as the specification file.
